requirement_text.REQ-124: MOB-2 (docs/mobile/requirements.md) needs GET /tenant-config to return { realm_url, locales, default_locale, branding, environment_kind } WITHOUT a bearer token: the mobile app calls it to discover which realm to authenticate against, so by definition it has no token yet. Verified against lib/ on 2026-08-21, this is two gaps, not one: (a) Letflow.Routers.TenantConfig is a stub whose routes land in REQ-078; and (b) Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline mounts it behind Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline, so implementing the route is not sufficient -- it would still demand the token the caller cannot have. Resolve (b) explicitly: either an unauthenticated variant mounted ahead of AuthPipeline, or a documented exemption inside it. Pick one and record why in the moduledoc. This is the gate for the entire mobile tier -- without it the app cannot reach a login screen -- which is why it is sequenced first in docs/mobile/build-order.md phase M-0. Security scope: an unauthenticated endpoint returning per-tenant data is a tenant-data path by definition and needs SECURITY-REVIEWER. The response must expose only what bootstrap requires. Check the shape field-by-field against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md -- in particular whether an unauthenticated caller enumerating slugs can learn which tenants exist, and what the answer should be for a slug that does not exist.

task.description: Validate lib/letflow/design/req124-mobile-tenant-config.md per WF-02 Step 1b's standard procedure (docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md). Read the design artefact directly -- do not read CODE-DESIGNER's handoff result.summary as a substitute. Give explicit attention to three open questions the design itself flags rather than silently resolving: OQ-1 (locales/default_locale/branding/environment_kind sourced from global config, not per-tenant, because Tenant schema has no backing column and no migration is authorized for this requirement -- confirm this is an acceptable scope boundary, not a silent under-delivery of MOB-2), OQ-2 (mobile route has no ?host= branch, only ?slug=), and OQ-3 (branding's internal sub-schema is the design's own proposal, not pinned by any existing contract). Also confirm the new-route-vs-discriminator decision in §1 is adequately justified (it is a real design choice with tradeoffs stated, not a placeholder) and that the exact-shape test strategy in §9 (Map.keys sorted-equality assertion) and the unknown-slug/anti-enumeration justification in §4 are both concrete enough for TEST-DESIGNER and ELIXIR-DEV to build against without further judgement calls.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST/acceptance criterion in the requirement has a corresponding design element -- no TBD/deferral language
Function signatures fully specified: name, inputs, outputs, error cases (including mobile_config_map/1's exact 5-key shape)
Error handling shape stated as tagged tuples / explicit branches, not left implicit
No implementation code present -- signatures and type shapes only, no .ex code bodies
